第3章 黑子的篮球三
自从发现了彼此的共同爱好后，原田和黑子迅速建立了坚固的革命友谊。
当然，还有经常来找黑子的青峰。照青峰开玩笑的话来讲，就是“作为第一个向我告白的男生，你当然应该时刻和我在一起才对”————为此某律在翻白眼多次无用下已经拒绝作出回应。
回到学校以后，原田立刻向篮球部递交了入部申请。
而本来由于人数已经有一百多人已经不想再有新成员的赤司本想看也不看就拒绝掉的，却被在一边休息的青峰看到。
“欸？律要加入篮球部？”
赤司挑眉，“你认识这个人？”
青峰点点头，“啊，他在oneone时赢了我。”随后小声嘟囔“虽然用了些小把戏…恶劣的家伙…”
赤司显然被挑起了兴趣，“哦？他很强吗？”
青峰耸耸肩，“不知道。但他的体形可不占优势。”注意到身旁的赤司眼神有些危险之后，立刻改口，“啊，不过这不影响一个人是否很强啦，赤司你就很强啊娱乐女教皇！”
就在青峰在赤司似笑非笑的表情下就要举手投降时，赤司转移了视线，淡淡的声音却充满了威严，“那么就青峰亲自去通知他吧，下午放学后过来测试。”
青峰有些疑惑，作为普通部员是不需要测试的，不然哪能有一百多人？不过赤司的话是不容质疑的，习惯了听从赤司的青峰只是点了点头，道，“我知道了。”
于是乎，当我们的原田童鞋正在教室里昏昏欲睡时，青峰的高大身躯就像一座大山般笼罩了他。
迷迷糊糊地抬头，原田剔透的茶色眼眸出现在青峰的眼前，因为困意而蒙上一层水雾的眼睛如同宝石般，褪去了那层带着点点恶劣的表现，看起来又竟很是可爱。
青峰大大咧咧的笑道。“哟，没看出来，律你长得也挺好看的嘛。”
迷糊中的原田迅速清醒了过来，挑眉道，“我原来很丑吗？”
青峰立刻转移话题。“啊，赤司说让你放学后到篮球部去，要对你进行测试。”
测试？原田有点疑惑，不过还是点点头表示了解。“知道了。谢谢你来告诉我啊。”
青峰摆了摆手便大步离开了a班的教室，那背影怎么看都带着点落荒而逃的意味。（......）
原田想了想青峰有没有做啥对不起自己的事，搜寻了一圈发现没有，便无所谓的耸耸肩，趴到桌上，与某位周姓先生约会去了。

放学后原田来到b班找黑子，那个家伙果然在最后一排，大大方方走进去把某只打包带走之后，黑子才反应过来，“律？”
原田眼睛眨啊眨，“哲也，我申请了篮球部，以后我每天放学后来找你然后一起去训练~”
黑子带着了然的表情，“你也报了篮球部啊。”
“可是哦，”原田有些疑惑，“我怎么不记得入篮球部还要测试的呢？”
黑子想想摇摇头，“我也没有印象。不过没关系，律君一定可以入部的。”
看到黑子透着信任的认真目光，原田欢乐地上前，扑倒，扭啊扭。“最喜欢黑子了~”
发现黑子的耳根又泛起了红，原田窝在黑子怀里蹭啊蹭，笑的像只偷腥的猫。
等原田松开黑子后，某个无良的机械声音破坏了原田的好心情。
“玩家完成隐藏支线任务，拥抱黑子哲也三分钟，系统奖励玩家每天五分钟超强命中率，希望玩家再接再厉。”
......抱小黑子明明是因为我萌动了，为什么非要来掺上一脚变成这种诡异的感觉。= =
算了，反正咱也不吃亏。
做好心理工作的原田有恢复了正常，和黑子一块来到了篮球社。
不得不说帝光不愧为以篮球著称的学校，巨大又华丽的篮球场就可以说明学校对于篮球部有多么重视了。感叹球场之大的原田眼尖的看到了门口有着粉红发色的少女，啊啦，自己的面子应该没有这么大，那么桃井五月是在等小黑子吗？
果然，不等两人走进，桃井就朝黑子扑了过来，把小黑子按在自己胸前蹭啊蹭。
“哲也今天也很可爱呢~”原田黑线。
大概是感觉到原田的视线，桃井偏过头来睁大猫瞳看着他，眯起眼鬼妃计最新章节。
“有点面生哎…啊，你就是今天申请入部的原田君吗？”
见原田点头后，桃井放开黑子微笑着朝原田伸出手。
“初次见面，我是篮球部的经理桃井五月。”
原田勾起一抹友好的笑容，握住了桃井伸到面前的手，“请多关照。”

桃井带着两人进到场内，里面各自分工且场地划分有序，让原田在心中暗暗点头。
原田看看黑子，“哲也你要去训练吗？”意料之中又是意料之外的看到黑子摇摇头，“不，我先看你测试完再一起去。”
一起…啊…原田不由自主地勾起嘴角，小黑子这么信任自己感觉很开心呢。
桃井的闪过什么，随即带两人来到正在写些什么的赤司面前。
正在训练的青峰看到原田的到来停下了手上的动作，朝他走过来，“哟！”
赤司闻声抬起头，不动声色打量着原田。
原田颇有些不自在，赤司的目光太富有侵略性，让原田觉得自己就像被蛇盯上的青蛙，本来没什么感觉的在这样的目光下不由带上了些不自在。
还好赤司很快收回了目光，站起来微微颔首，“篮球部部长。赤司征十郎。”
原田立刻回答道，“你好，我是原田律。请多关照。”
赤司漫不经心的眯起眼道，“别急着让我关照，等你通过了测试再说。”
原田愣了一下，这个人还真是…一点都不客气。
原田没有说什么，倒是一边的青峰有些不满的道，“赤司，律是我和哲的朋友。”
赤司扫了青峰一眼，让某人闭了嘴。
随即看向原田，“测试就是在罚球线上投篮，超过连续五十个命中你就可以入部，可以吧。”
原田听着这像是刻意刁难的话语反而很是庆幸，别的他真不行，但就是投篮他不怕，毕竟有系统这个作弊器，五分钟之内自己绝对可以完成。
正想松口气答应下来时，某个机械的声音又响了起来。
“玩家触发随机任务，给赤司一个吻。任务完成将绝佳手感延长至七分钟，失败目前父母失去工作。”
原田浑身僵硬。吻赤司？这人光一个眼神就让他浑身不自在了，给他一个吻，不说自己能不能接近他，就是真让他侥幸亲上了，自己一定会被赶出篮球部的啊啊…可是，自己必须完成，不说自己五个任务失败就消失，而且帝光的学费是很高的，如果现在的父母同时失业，自己照样要完蛋。
灵光一闪，原田想到也许并不需要那么麻烦。
“赤司君，如果我进了一百个，你能答应我一个要求吗？”

收到周围人无比惊悚的目光，原田破罐子破摔的以无所畏惧的眼神看着赤司，等待他的回答。
赤司以一种诡异的眼神盯着他看了好半天，然后突然笑了。
他说，“好啊。”
content_en:
Chapter 3 Kuroko’s Basketball III
Since discovering each other's common interests, Harada and Kuroko quickly established a solid revolutionary friendship.
Of course, there is also Aomine who often comes to Kuroko. According to Qingfeng's joking words, "As the first boy to confess to me, of course you should be with me all the time" - for this, a certain law has refused to respond after rolling his eyes many times in vain.
After returning to school, Harada immediately submitted an application to the basketball club.
Akashi, who originally didn't want any more new members since the number of people already numbered over a hundred, wanted to reject them without even looking at them, but was seen by Aomine who was resting aside.
"Huh? Ritsu wants to join the basketball club?"
Akashi raised his eyebrows, "Do you know this person?"
Qingfeng nodded, "Ah, he defeated me in OneOne." Then he muttered in a low voice, "Although he used some tricks... he is a bad guy..."
Akashi was obviously interested, "Oh? Is he strong?"
Aomine shrugged, "I don't know. But his body shape is not an advantage." After noticing the dangerous look in Akashi's eyes next to him, he immediately changed his words, "Ah, but this does not affect whether a person is strong. Akashi, you are very strong, entertainment female pope!"
Just when Aomine was about to raise his hands and surrender under Akashi's half-smiling expression, Akashi shifted his gaze, and his faint voice was full of majesty, "Then Aomine will inform him personally and come over for the test after school in the afternoon."
Qingfeng was a little confused. As an ordinary member, there was no need to test. Otherwise, how could there be more than a hundred people? However, Akashi's words cannot be questioned. Aomine, who is used to obeying Akashi, just nodded and said, "I understand."
Ever since, when our Harada children's shoes were falling asleep in the classroom, Aomine's tall body enveloped him like a mountain.
He raised his head drowsily, and Harada's clear brown eyes appeared in front of Aomine's eyes. The eyes that were covered with water mist due to sleepiness were like gems, with the layer of a little bit of bad expression gone, and they looked very cute again.
Qingfeng smiled broadly. "Oh, I didn't realize it, but you're pretty good-looking too, Ritsu."
Harada quickly woke up from his daze, raised his eyebrows and asked, "Am I ugly?"
Aomine immediately changed the topic. "Ah, Akaashi asked you to go to the basketball club after school to test you."
Test? Harada was a little confused, but nodded to show understanding. "I know. Thank you for telling me."
Qingfeng waved his hand and strode out of Class A's classroom. His back looked like he was running away. (...)
Harada thought for a moment whether Aomine had done anything to make him feel sorry for him. After searching around and finding out if he had found any, he shrugged indifferently, lay down on the table, and went on a date with a certain Mr. Zhou.
After school, Harada came to Class B to look for Kuroko. As expected, the guy was in the last row. He walked in generously and packed up a certain bird and took it away. Kuroko finally realized, "Ritsu?"
Harada blinked, "Tetsuya, I applied for the basketball club. From now on, I will come to you after school every day and go to training together~"
Heizi said with a knowing expression, "You also signed up for the basketball club."
"But," Harada was a little confused, "Why didn't I remember that I had to take a test when I joined the basketball club?"
Kuroko thought about it and shook his head, "I have no impression either. But it doesn't matter, Ritsu-kun will definitely be able to join the club."
Seeing Kuroko's serious look of trust, Harada stepped forward happily, threw himself down, and twisted. "I like Kuroko the most~"
Noticing that Kuroko's ears were turning red again, Harada nuzzled into Kuroko's arms, smiling like a naughty cat.
After Harada let go of Kuroko, an unscrupulous mechanical sound ruined Harada's good mood.
"The player completes the hidden side mission and hugs Kuroko Tetsuya for three minutes. The system rewards the player with five minutes of super hit rate every day. I hope the player will continue toKeep up the good work. "
...I hugged the little Heizi because I was obviously attracted to him, so why did he have to mess with me to make me feel this weird? = =
Forget it, we won’t suffer anyway.
Harada returned to normal after doing a good job in psychological work, and came to the basketball club with Kuroko.
I have to say that Teikou is worthy of being a school famous for basketball. The huge and gorgeous basketball court shows how much the school attaches importance to the basketball department. Harada, who lamented the size of the stadium, saw the pink-haired girl at the door with sharp eyes, ah, he should not be so proud, so is Satsuki Momoi waiting for Kuroko?
Sure enough, before the two of them walked in, Momoi rushed towards Kuroko, pressing Kuroko against her chest and rubbing against her.
"Tetsuya is also very cute today~" Harada said.
Probably feeling Harada's gaze, Momoi turned her head and looked at him with wide-open eyes, then narrowed her eyes.
"It's a bit unfamiliar...ah, are you Harada-kun who applied to join the club today? "
After seeing Harada nod, Momoi let go of Kuroko and smiled and stretched out her hand towards Harada.
"First time meeting me, I am Satsuki Momoi, the manager of the basketball department. "
Harada put on a friendly smile and took Momoi's hand in front of him, "Please take care of me. "
Momoi led the two people into the venue, where they had their own division of labor and the place was organized in an orderly manner, making Harada nod secretly in his heart.
Harada looked at Kuroko, "Tetsuya, are you going to train? "Unexpectedly and yet unexpectedly, Heizi shook his head, "No, I'll see you finish the test first before we go together. "
Together... ah... Harada couldn't help but raise the corners of his lips. He felt very happy that Xiao Heizi trusted him so much.
Momoi flashed something, and then brought the two of them to Akashi who was writing something.
Aomine, who was training, stopped what he was doing when he saw Harada arriving and walked towards him, "Yo! "
Akashi raised his head when he heard the sound and looked at Harada calmly.
Harada was quite uncomfortable. Akashi's gaze was too aggressive, making Harada feel like a frog being stared at by a snake. He didn't feel anything at all, but he couldn't help but feel a little uncomfortable under such a gaze.
Fortunately, Akashi quickly retracted his gaze, stood up and nodded slightly, "Head of the Basketball Department. Akashi Seijuro. "
Harada immediately replied, “Hello, I am Ritsu Harada. Please take care of me. "
Akashi narrowed his eyes casually and said, "Don't be in a hurry to ask me to take care of you, wait until you pass the test. "
Harada was stunned for a moment, this person was really...not polite at all.
Harada didn't say anything, but Aomine on the side said with some dissatisfaction, "Akaashi, Ritsu is a friend of Tetsu and I. "
Akashi glanced at Aomine, silencing someone.
Then he looked at Harada, "The test is to shoot at the free throw line. If you make more than 50 consecutive hits, you can join the team, okay. "
Harada was very happy to hear these words that seemed to be deliberately difficult. He was really bad at other things, but he was not afraid of shooting. After all, with the cheating device of the system, he could definitely complete it within five minutes.
Just when he was about to sigh in relief and agree, a mechanical voice sounded again.
"The player triggers a random mission and gives Akaashi a kiss. Mission accomplished extends the excellent feel to seven minutes, failure currently results in parents losing their jobs. "
Harada was stiff all over. Kiss Akashi? Just one look from this man made him feel uncomfortable. If he gave him a kiss and didn't say whether he could get close to him or not, but he was lucky enough to kiss him, he would definitely be kicked out of the basketball club... However, he had to complete it, and he would disappear without saying that he had failed five tasks. Moreover, Teikou's tuition was very high. If his parents lost their jobs at the same time, he would still be finished.
With a flash of inspiration, Harada thought that maybe it didn't need to be so troublesome.
"Akaashi-kun, if I get into a hundred, can you agree to my request? "
Receiving extremely horrifying looks from the people around him, Harada broke the jar.He looked at Akashi with fearless eyes, waiting for his answer.
Akashi stared at him with a strange look for a long time, and then suddenly smiled.
He said, "Okay."
